acceptance_note: Only A01/A02 deterministic one-aircraft mapped mission/binding observables: 72 half-hour intervals, integrals, terminal counts, stable identities and event times. Notification is a commission-time proxy, not an independent captured notification; no same-time priority claim. No native re-execution, GUI acceptance, fault/resource/stock/cancellation/F35/J35 equivalence, RNG-stream equivalence or performance claim. SIMPE=36h is separate from RCEND; MSUF is not a window-end completion count.
